sample_mapping_evidence: One deposited source-assigned donor object per biological specimen; technical channels combined by source authors. Nine original pregnant donors only; 17 earlier MGH comparator donors held for overlap review.

title: Pregnant, COVID asymptomatic, patient 324058-ASX (GEX)
extract_protocol_ch1: Cryopreserved PBMC samples. Full details are in the manuscript.
RNA libraries were prepared for sequencing using standard Illumina protocols
description: An AnnData object that contains both normalized counts and raw counts of this sample, in the raw layer.
data_processing: Alignment with CellRanger (v6.0.1), genetic demultiplexing using Souporcell (v2.0), count matrices were aggregated using Pegasus (v1.7.1, python).
GEX count matrices were log-normalized, ADT count matrices were CLR normalized.
PCA was calculated, harmony was used for batch-correciton and the harmony-based PCs were used to create a UMAP and clustering using the leiden algorithm (all of these using Pegasus, python)

Supplementary files format and content: GEX files include the leiden clustering, sample info, n_genes is the number of genes per cell, n_count is the number of UMIs per cell, percent_mito is the percent of mitochondrial transcript in the cell.
Supplementary files format and content: AllCells_GEX.h5ad.tar.gz - include GEX data of cells from all samples. This object has clustering information, PCs, UMAP and differential analysis info.

Supplementary files format and content: B_Plasma_GEX_BCR.h5ad.tar.gz - include GEX data of B cells from all samples. This object has clustering information, PCs, UMAP, differential analysis info and BCR data.

Supplementary files format and content: CD4T_GEX_TCR.h5ad.tar.gz - include GEX data of CD4 T cells from all samples. This object has clustering information, PCs, UMAP, differential analysis info and TCR data.

Supplementary files format and content: CD8T_GEX_TCR.h5ad.tar.gz - include GEX data of CD8 T cells from all samples. This object has clustering information, PCs, UMAP, differential analysis info and TCR data.
Supplementary files format and content: Myeloid.h5ad.tar.gz - include GEX data of MNP cells from all samples. This object has clustering information, PCs, UMAP and differential analysis info.

Supplementary files format and content: T_NK_interim.h5ad.tar.gz - includes GEX data from all MK,  CD4 T and CD8 T cells before splitting to CD4/CD8 T cells. This object includes the UMAP and clustering we based out split on.

source_metadata.access: Public processed counts; raw sequence access restricted and not required
source_metadata.normalization_coverage: All genes retained in deposited raw.X; original upstream removed genes cannot be restored
